description: One call returns an address's native coin, USDC and USDT balances on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC and Avalanche (or a 'chains' subset), plus a total stablecoin USD figure, instead of 21 separate reads. Chains whose RPC fails are listed in chainsFailed. You only pay for successful reads: invalid input, not-found and upstream errors cancel settlement. ($0.005 USDC on Base)

chains.description: Optional comma-separated subset, e.g. base,arbitrum. Defaults to all 7 chains.

name: chain_portfolio
